changeSet.author: KMcNamee
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER view [dbo].[AssetDetail] as (select A.ID, A.AssetTypeID, A.State, A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.SourceID, ADV.DisplayValue, K.KeyHash, F.FieldHash, A.CreatedOn, A.CreatedBy, A.UpdatedOn, A.UpdatedBy, A.AssetTypeClass, A.AssetTypeDescription, A.TypeName, A.Type, A.TypeID, A.BackColor, A.ForeColor, A.Icon, A.UID from AssetWithType A inner join AssetDisplayValue ADV on ADV.AssetID = A.ID
outer apply [dbo].[GetAssetKeyHashById](A.ID) K left join GetAssetFieldHash() F on F.ID = A.ID where A.[Object] != 'FusionAttribute') union all (select A.ID, A.AssetTypeID, A.State, A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.SourceID, FA.[Name] as DisplayValue, K.KeyHash, F.FieldHash, A.CreatedOn, A.CreatedBy, A.UpdatedOn, A.UpdatedBy, A.AssetTypeClass, A.AssetTypeDescription, A.TypeName, A.Type, A.TypeID, A.BackColor, A.ForeColor, A.Icon, A.UID from AssetWithType A inner join dbo.FusionAttribute FA on (FA.ID = A.ObjectID and A.[Object] = 'FusionAttribute') outer apply [dbo].[GetAssetKeyHashById](A.ID) K left join GetAssetFieldHash() F on (F.ID = A.ID) ) GO
changeSet.rollback:
CREATE OR ALTER view [dbo].[AssetDetail] as select A.ID, A.AssetTypeID, A.State, A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.SourceID, D.DisplayValue, K.KeyHash, F.FieldHash, A.CreatedOn, A.CreatedBy, A.UpdatedOn, A.UpdatedBy, A.AssetTypeClass, A.AssetTypeDescription, A.TypeName, A.Type, A.TypeID, A.BackColor, A.ForeColor, A.Icon, A.UID from AssetWithType A cross apply dbo.GetAssetDisplayValueById(A.ID) D
outer apply [dbo].[GetAssetKeyHashById](A.ID) K left join GetAssetFieldHash() F on F.ID = A.ID
GO
